objective: Form a scientifically conservative release-candidate set of at least 20 distinct recent-source Temporal families after enforcing an actual-manipulation control gate and replaying the accepted cards through admission v2 and both benchmark task settings.
unit_of_analysis: one source paper contributing at most one Temporal family

inputs.old_frozen_artifact_policy: Read only. This experiment creates new validation records and does not amend any prior frozen manifest, review, ScienceCard, or constructed case.

scientific_admission.mandatory_control_gate: Every Player control must be a numeric quantity actually set or manipulated in the source-reported experiment, computation, or protocol. Measurements, fitted quantities, uncertainty intervals, passive coordinates, theoretical constants, and sample-size exposure are not controls merely because they are numeric.
scientific_admission.eligibility_rule: An accepted card must pass the actual-control gate and all eight admission-v2 precompile checks, parse with strict lineage against its fixed source packet, compile deterministically, and pass known-truth evaluation in Identification and Discovery.
scientific_admission.postcompile_check: constructed_case_fidelity is evaluated after compilation and is intentionally not one of the eight admission-v2 precompile checks.

core_selection.rule: Sort every accepted family by frozen production cohort number and then by frozen paper order. Designate the first 20 as core20 and every later accepted family as an extension.
core_selection.reason: The rule uses acquisition metadata rather than model scores, difficulty, or observed benchmark performance.

reviewer_profile.claim_boundary: The record supports source-grounded release-candidate status only; it is not an independent human or domain-expert certification.

interpretation_limits: Acceptance here concerns one source-reported executable quantitative relation, not novelty, importance, representativeness, or benchmark difficulty.
Known-truth success is a deterministic pipeline canary and is not an LLM performance result.
No benchmark-authored Temporal counterfactual variant has been constructed by this experiment.
The public Temporal case registry is not modified by this experiment.
The requested 160-case core benchmark cannot yet be described as ready from this record alone.
A post-cutoff, unseen, or contamination-free claim is not established because the authoring/review runtime has no frozen documented knowledge cutoff.
This record was assembled after the targeted validations; it must not be represented as a preregistration of those reviews.
